$comment: Conditional tool-use rules. Each rule pairs a skill invocation pattern (skillGateRegEx) with a tool-call trigger; when the skill is invoked, captured variables open a 'gate' that authorises specific tool patterns until timeout. Rule order matters: the first rule whose trigger matches the flattened tool command is the only one consulted. Place more-specific triggers before broader ones. Variables inside conditionalAllow regex use {name} syntax and reference the named capture groups of skillGateRegEx. Captured values are regex-escaped before substitution.

rules.name: deploy-to-google-cloud
rules.description: Allow gcloud mutating commands only when /deployToGoogleCloud was invoked with a matching project and env. Read-only gcloud commands are always allowed; destructive org/IAM/project-delete commands are always denied. All other gcloud subcommands require the gate to be open and target the captured project; resource names targeting Cloud Run additionally require the env suffix.
